    segments = case['segments']
    n = len(segments)
    names = [seg['name'] for seg in segments]
    importances = [seg['importance'] for seg in segments]
    minima = [seg['minimum'] for seg in segments]
    capacities = [seg['capacity'] for seg in segments]
    budget = case['budget']
    total_min = sum(minima)
    total_max = sum(capacities)
    if budget < total_min or budget > total_max:
        raise ValueError("Budget infeasible")
    allocations = list(minima)
    remaining = budget - total_min
    # Precompute full mask
    full = [allocations[i] == capacities[i] for i in range(n)]
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_num = 0
        best_den = 1  # placeholder
        for i in range(n):
            if full[i]:
                continue
            # candidate next token would be at position allocations[i] + 1
            den = allocations[i] + 1
            num = importances[i]
            if best_idx == -1:
                best_idx = i
                best_num = num
                best_den = den
            else:
                # compare num/den vs best_num/best_den
                # num * best_den vs best_num * den
                left = num * best_den
                right = best_num * den
                if left > right or (left == right and i < best_idx):
                    best_idx = i
                    best_num = num
                    best_den = den
        if best_idx == -1:
            # should not happen because remaining > 0 and some capacity left
            raise ValueError("No segment eligible")
        allocations[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
        if allocations[best_idx] == capacities[best_idx]:
            full[best_idx] = True
    by_name = {names[i]: allocations[i] for i in range(n)}
    total = sum(allocations)
    return {
        'allocations': allocations,
        'by_name': by_name,
        'total': total
    }"
